decisions.briefing: Stocks fell across the board today, with the NASDAQ down 1.2% and the S&P 500 down 1.1%, so the screener returned no new candidates. I am holding all 7 positions and leaving the $545.88 in cash uninvested for now. The automatic stop-loss and profit-target rules stay in place to protect each position.

market_education.summary_en: Both major U.S. indexes fell more than 1% today. The NASDAQ (-1.2%) dropped slightly more than the S&P 500 (-1.1%), which suggests growth and tech stocks bore most of the selling. No news headlines were included in today's data, so a specific cause can't be named with confidence, but a broad drop across both indexes usually means investors are cutting risk overall rather than reacting to one company.
market_education.summary_zh: 美股今日全線回落，兩大指數跌幅均逾1%。納指跌1.2%，略多於標普500的1.1%，顯示沽壓主要集中於增長股及科技股。由於今日數據未附相關新聞標題，暫難確定下跌的具體原因；不過兩大指數同步走弱，通常反映投資者整體減低風險，而非針對個別企業消息作出反應。

daily_lesson.explanation_en: A risk-off day is when investors get nervous and sell riskier assets such as growth stocks, moving their money into safer places. When this happens, broad indexes like the NASDAQ and S&P 500 tend to fall together. A disciplined investor often holds off on new buys during risk-off days and waits for calmer conditions instead of trying to catch a falling market.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 「避險情緒」（Risk-Off）指投資者轉趨審慎，沽出增長股等較高風險資產，並將資金轉移至較穩健的避險工具。在這種環境下，納指及標普500等大市指數往往同步下跌。紀律嚴明的投資者通常會暫停建立新倉，待市況回穩後再部署，而非急於在跌市中接貨。
